forearm_specialized.name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Grip a barbell with palms facing down (overhand).

Lower slowly.

tibialis_anterior.name: Tibialis Raise (band)
instructions: Anchor a band low and loop it around your foot.
Sit with leg extended, foot relaxed.
Pull your toes toward your shin against the band.
Return slowly.

tibialis_anterior.name: Tibialis Raise (dumbbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your heel resting on the floor and a light dumbbell placed on top of your foot.
Hold the dumbbell in place with your hand if needed.
Lift your toes upward, flexing at the ankle.
Lower slowly.

hip_flexors.name: Banded Psoas March
hip_flexors.progression: heavier band or 3-second pause at the top
instructions: Band looped around both feet, standing tall.
Drive one knee up to hip height against the band tension.
Control the descent fully; trunk does not sway.

erectors.name: Back Extension
instructions: Position yourself on a hyperextension bench.
Cross your arms and hinge forward at the hips.
Raise your torso until it's in line with your legs.
Pause, then lower.

stretching_static.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
stretching_static.progression: hold longer or widen doorway grip
instructions: Forearm on door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward until you feel the front of your shoulder and chest open.
Keep ribs down; breathe slowly for the full hold.

stretching_static.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch (strap)
stretching_static.progression: pull leg 2-3 degrees closer each week
instructions: Lie on your back, loop a strap or towel around one foot.
Keep the raised leg nearly straight and the lower back flat.
Hold the tension point, never a sharp pain.

stretching_static.name: Figure-Four Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest.
Keep the neck relaxed and shoulders down.

stretching_static.name: Couch Stretch (Quad and Hip Flexor)
stretching_static.progression: walk hands higher up the wall over time
instructions: Rear foot up on a couch or wall, knee on the floor.
Squeeze the rear glute and stand tall through the torso.
Do not arch the lower back; keep ribs stacked.

stretching_static.name: Soleus Wall Stretch (bent knee)
stretching_static.progression: press knee closer to the wall over time
instructions: Ball of foot on the wall, heel down.
Bend the back knee toward the wall while the heel stays planted.
Feel the deep lower calf, not the upper calf.

stretching_static.name: Gastrocnemius Wall Stretch (straight leg)
instructions: Hands on wall, one leg back, knee perfectly straight.
Heel glued to the floor, toes pointing forward.
Lean the whole body as one rigid line.

stretching_static.name: Childs Pose (Lats and Back)
stretching_static.progression: reach hands further to one side for each lat
instructions: Kneel, sit hips toward heels, arms long on the floor.
Breathe into the sides of the ribs and let the back widen.
Walk both hands to one side to bias each lat.

stretching_static.name: Supine Twist
stretching_static.progression: increase hold time before pulling deeper
instructions: Lie on your back, arms out in a T.
Drop both knees to one side, shoulders pinned down.
Slow nasal breathing; switch sides after the hold.

stretching_static.name: Doorway Lat Stretch
stretching_static.progression: lower the grip to shift the stretch
instructions: Grip a door frame or rack at hip height.
Sit hips back with a flat back until the armpit line lengthens.
Keep the shoulder blade pulled down, not shrugged.

stretching_static.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretching_static.progression: raise the arm angle to bias rear delt
instructions: Pull one arm across the chest with the other hand above the elbow.
Keep the shoulder blade back; do not let it wing forward.
Hold gently — the rear cuff is small.

stretching_static.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Elbow pointing to the ceiling, hand reaching down the back.
Gently pull the elbow back with the opposite hand.
Keep the neck long and ribs down.

stretching_static.name: Neck Lateral Flexion Stretch
instructions: Sit tall, let one ear fall toward the same-side shoulder.
The opposite hand rests on the head with zero pull, or a feather-light guide.
Keep the jaw and shoulders relaxed.

stretching_static.name: Neck Extensor Stretch (chin tuck)
stretching_static.progression: add a gentle two-finger guide under the chin
instructions: Interlace fingers behind the head for support only.
Nod the chin down and slightly back, making a double chin.
Feel the back of the neck lengthen; no pain, ever.

stretching_static.name: Butterfly Groin Stretch
stretching_static.progression: sit taller instead of pressing harder
instructions: Soles of the feet together, knees dropped wide.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Let gravity work; never bounce the knees.

stretching_static.name: Seated Forward Fold
stretching_static.progression: reach toward the heels with a flat back first
instructions: Legs long, hinge forward from the hips.
Round only at the very end, exhaling into it.
Knees may stay slightly bent to protect the back.

stretching_static.name: Wrist Flexor and Extensor Stretch
instructions: One arm long, palm out, fingers down; gently extend the wrist.
Then flip palm down and gently flex the other way.
Both sides — desk and barbell work shorten these.

stretching_static.name: Deep Squat Hold
stretching_static.progression: remove the heel support over time
instructions: Squat as deep as possible, heels down if you can.
Use elbows to gently push the knees out.
Stay tall through the chest; breathe into the hips.

stretching_static.name: Thoracic Open Book Rotation
stretching_static.progression: hold the top position longer each week
instructions: Lie on your side, knees stacked, arms long.
Open the top arm like a book, following it with your eyes.
Keep the knees glued together.

stretching_static.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch
stretching_static.progression: slowly rotate through positions over time
instructions: Sit with front leg and rear leg both at 90 degrees.
Tall spine, lean the chest toward the front shin.
Feel the front hip deepen; switch sides.

stretching_static.name: Kneeling Tibialis Stretch
stretching_static.progression: sit hips closer to heels over time
instructions: Kneel, toes tucked under, sit back toward the heels.
Keep the shins long and the weight even.
A mild stretch along the front of the shin is the target.
